roster_report.pass_rule: Pass iff the fixed policy accepts the case text exactly when expected_accept is true. Rejection includes parser ValueError or RecursionError. Curated acceptance checks, not a representative performance sample.

analysis.method: Envelope of complete-data Paired Bounds over every binary completion; exact outward binomial bounds
assumptions: Latent complete case vectors are independent identically distributed draws from the target population.
Retain the fixed planned case set and full candidate family, including wholly missing rows and columns.
Observed 0/1 outcomes are correct; ? means unknown, never an observed pass or fail.
No missing-at-random assumption is needed: every binary completion is enclosed, even outcome-dependent masking.
Fix final sample size, pass rule, family, alpha and margin before observing outcomes; no repeated looks or optional stopping.
Unlisted or selectively omitted cases, correlated cases, selected families and incorrect observed labels invalidate coverage.
Sample identification bounds describe possible completed sample means, not population confidence bounds.
Non-establishment of a criterion is inconclusive; pins establish byte identity, not honesty or prospective choices.

limits: Unknowns are not measured outcomes. Restored rows are explicitly recorded, never scored as failures.
Retain the plan pin before observations; hashes prove byte identity, not timing, execution or honesty.
This legacy plan binds case IDs and labels, not case payloads or system code.
Margin is caller-supplied and NOT covered by the legacy plan pin; choose and retain it prospectively.
Use once at the fixed endpoint. Completing missing observations is not permission for optional stopping.
The enclosed analysis retains its iid latent-case, fixed-family and accurate-scoring assumptions.
The outer protocol pin additionally binds margin and omission policy; the nested legacy-plan caveat applies only to its own pin.
Retain this protocol pin independently before outcomes. Hashes do not establish timing, honest execution or scoring.
IDs do not bind case payloads or executable bytes. Preserve those separately, for example with Benchmark Seal.
Fixed sample size, iid latent case vectors, full family and accurate scoring remain assumptions. No optional stopping or selective publication.
Restoration preserves unknown outcomes and the denominator; it does not measure missing cases.

display.rounding_error_means: display minus exact, in percentage points

limits: Original rational intervals and decisions are retained unchanged; displayed intervals are enlarged outward.
Coverage requires latent complete case vectors to be independent identically distributed draws, with fixed planned rows and full candidate family.
Every planned row is retained; ? is unknown, never imputed as pass or failure. Unlisted cases cannot be detected.
Sample identification intervals describe possible completed sample means, not population confidence bounds.
No missing-at-random assumption is needed; every binary completion is enclosed. This does not repair selective omission, optional stopping or inaccurate observations.
Coverage is repeated-sampling, not a posterior probability; rounding adds no measurement evidence.
The practical margin is an absolute rate difference: 0.1 means ten percentage points, not a relative percent improvement.
Displayed comparisons use the exact unrounded margin and may be inconclusive when the original criterion passes.
A false criterion does not establish its opposite; do not choose precision, margin or family after inspecting outcomes.
Input pins prove byte identity, not honest execution, representative sampling or prospective choices.
Retain the protocol pin independently before observations; a hash does not prove when choices were made.
Alpha, family, roster, margin and omission policy come from the verified protocol. Display precision is not pinned.
Lower endpoints round down and upper endpoints round up; precision cannot create an exact criterion.
The nested legacy-plan margin caveat concerns its inner pin; the outer protocol additionally binds margin and omission policy.
Original observation, protocol-byte and normalized-CSV identities are separate. Unknowns are never invented observations.
Fixed sample size, iid latent case vectors, full prospective family and accurate scoring remain assumptions.
No optional stopping, selective reporting, measurement validation, execution attestation or deployment recommendation.
Case IDs do not bind payloads or executable bytes; retain those separately, for example with Benchmark Seal.

execution.limitations: Local ordering of steps is not independent preregistration or execution attestation. Hand-selected related cases are not iid population samples; confidence bounds here illustrate arithmetic only.
